hypothesis: SI-0007 — no governed document can carry both a provenance and a standing authority value, because `authority` is a single-valued enum and no other provenance field exists.
falsification_condition: ONE document carrying both a P value and an S value. Stated BEFORE execution.
design: Parse YAML frontmatter of all governed docs under docs/knowledge/ and engineering/ (worktrees excluded). Partition authority values into P={generated,derived} and S={authoritative,provisional,historical}. Count documents whose value set intersects both.
interpretation: ⭐ The strongest available form of the result: BOTH dimensions are in active use (derived 10x, authoritative 15x), so 10 documents had to CHOOSE provenance and thereby forfeit standing. The unsatisfiability is not an artefact of an unused dimension.
scope_limit: ⚠️ Validates a SCHEMA DEFECT only. Does NOT validate the theory of authority (PM-1 open). Says NOTHING about the promotion mechanism, which is the candidate theory's core.
maturity_effect: SI-0007 -> MATHEMATICAL_VALIDATION + EMPIRICAL corroboration. ⛔ NOT M3 — M2 still requires an independent reader (§11.0).
